# Rule: Internal declaration coordinates shifted

_Canonical rule slug:_ `internal-declaration-coordinates-shifted`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> An internal declaration is matched across releases with neither its name nor its declaring file actually changed, so the reconciliation reports a compatible coordinate-only shift rather than a break or a real rename/move.
